recalls.product: epoc BGEM BUN Test Card (25 pk) for the epoc Blood Analysis System, SMN 10736515
recalls.reason: Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics Inc. has confirmed that a negative sodium bias may exist in one lot of epoc BGEM BUN Test Cards approximately 2 months prior to expiration. The observed maximum negative bias from internal testing is -10 mmol/L. No positive bias has been observed. Quality Control (QC)
